title: Python Numbers
description: There are three numeric types in Python: int, float, and complex.
example:
x = 1    # int
y = 2.8  # float
z = 1j   # complex

challenges.title: Check Type
challenges.exercise: Create x = 5. Find its type using type(x) and print it.

challenges.title: Float Science
challenges.exercise: Create x = 35e3. Print it. What kind of number is it?
